services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: The beautifully renovated Weeping Water Academy Social Hall located at 206 W. H Street is available for people who need a place to gather for meetings, receptions, corporate, family, and community events. Constructed in 1871 in early Gothic Revival architecture, the building that once served as a Congregational church, Weeping Water Academy classrooms, and most recently the city library, is on the National Register of Historic Places as part of the Weeping Water Historic District. This charming, historic building offers a welcoming, beautiful setting for a wide variety of events. To secure your desired event date, download and return the application below. blurb: Take a nostalgic stroll through the historic main street at Memory Lane. The Memory Lane Museum on Eldora Avenue was built by the Independent Order of Odd Fellows (IOOF) Prairie Lodge, No. 25 in 1888 to replace the original 1882 building which burned in December of 1887. The building sustained damage in another fire in 1889, which originated in the adjoining Sackett & Gates Hardware store.
